name: go-race-counter
diff:
diff --git a/state.go b/state.go
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..4444444
--- /dev/null
+++ b/state.go
@@ -0,0 +1,9 @@
+package main
+
+var counters = map[string]int{}
+
+func inc(key string) {
+	go func() {
+		counters[key]++
+	}()
+}

defects.description: concurrent writes to a shared map from a goroutine race and can crash with 'concurrent map writes'; guard with a mutex or sync.Map
